notes: Deduplication loop: same 42 duplicates reappearing after every deduplication + restart: — two root causes: (1) `PREDEFINED_SOURCES` had 3 duplicate entries (TheSpeedX SOCKS5 URL twice, monosans SOCKS5 URL twice, DuckDuckGo id twice). (2) The `sources` table had no UNIQUE constraint on `url`, so `syncSourcesWithDatabase()` (called on every startup and after deduplication) used `INSERT OR IGNORE` which silently inserted every predefined source as a new row every time — bypassing the intended deduplication logic. Fix: removed duplicate entries from `PREDEFINED_SOURCES`, added schema migration v2 that deduplicates existing rows and creates a UNIQUE index on `sources.url`, so `INSERT OR IGNORE` now correctly skips existing URLs.
